- 改了什么:ADR-0055 补记 2026-11-14 修订「读主记录即可写(按对象开关)」:状态区新增一行修订横幅,`:6`(ownerMayEdit 横幅)与 §3 规则处加 ⚠️ 指向;2026-10-26 修订里「方案 2 未采纳」两处只对声明了开关的对象解除(原文保留、不改史);2026-11-07 修订里「清空主记录问主记录编辑权」那句加注;文末新增完整修订节。
- 为什么改:PR #33369 已按 Leehom 裁定 A+ 上线 `writeRequiresMasterRead`,而 ADR 仍写着「方案 2 的门保持关闭」,与运行时相反;后来的评审会照 ADR 把行为「修回去」。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 ADR 文件(+52/−1),不动代码、schema、技能;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md` 文末「Amendment (2026-11-14, #33250)」节,重点是「两个席位裁量点」(链上非声明子对象、生命周期动词)与「不变式」两段。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md`,预期只见新增横幅/⚠️ 注与文末新节,原有句子仅 `:6` 一行在行尾追加 ⚠️ 注。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`docs/adr/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0055-master-detail-controlled-by-parent.md` (+52 / −1; the −1 is the `:6` banner line, kept verbatim with a ⚠️ note appended).

- **Status block.** A new `· **Amended** (2026-11-14, #33250 / PR #33369, ruling A+ 6880588685)` line after the 2026-11-07 line, and a ⚠️ note at the end of the `:6` `ownerMayEdit` banner (its "every other caller … keeps the master-edit rule" no longer holds on a detail that declares the new key).
- **§3 (`:69`).** A third ⚠️ line under the rule: a detail that declares `writeRequiresMasterRead` is asked read on its master; the rule stands at its own hop for every detail that does not.
- **2026-10-26 amendment (`:172`, `:188`).** A ⚠️ paragraph after each "Option 2 … was not chosen" / "Option 2's door … stays closed" line, lifting them for opted-in objects only. The 2026-10-25 ruling's text is not rewritten.
- **2026-11-07 amendment (`:247`).** A ⚠️ line under "Setting a master … Emptying one asks edit on the stored master": on an opted-in detail both masters are asked read through the same walk; the null-master row's owner rule still runs first.
- **New section "Amendment (2026-11-14, #33250): read on the master is enough to write, by opt-in"**: the ruling quoted verbatim; spec key, reader and both parse refusals; the gate's one swap point; every write shape that reaches it; what decides afterwards, with the ownership floors said in plain words (N3); on-behalf-of; the 404 / 403 answers and the served member's legs; the null-master row; the lint stand-down; the two seat calls for the veto window (contract review 6881744779 ① items 5 and 6); the precise invariant instead of "byte for byte" (N1); fail-closed boundaries; proof; what is unchanged.
